editorial:
Imagine being told your child has leukemia and the only way to save them is a bone marrow match that doesn't exist. You are dropped right into the heart of this family's nightmare. The story follows Anissa and her husband as they make a choice most people can't even imagine: having another baby specifically to serve as a donor. It is a heavy, emotional ride that feels very real because it actually happened. You will feel the stress, the hope, and the desperation as the parents gamble everything just to give their daughter a fighting chance at life.

The acting is solid and keeps you locked in, even though the pacing slows down in the middle. While it is a TV movie from the 90s, the raw emotion still hits hard today. If you like stories about family strength and medical miracles, you should definitely check this out. Since it is an older title, you might have to hunt for it on DVD or see if it is available for rent on Apple TV. If you find a high-quality digital version, it is a great addition to your watchlist for a night of deep emotions.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the birth of the second child, who is the perfect match for Anissa's daughter. After a tense wait, the bone marrow transplant takes place. The story wraps up on a hopeful note as the daughter's health improves thanks to her new sibling. It shows that the parents' risky plan actually worked, leaving you with a feeling of relief and a reminder of how far parents will go for their kids.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories about family courage and medical dramas.
